title: Pilot 1 of 4 -- coverage stack on TGB 2.0 tkgl-polecat: pre-registered decision rule
registered: 2026-10-12, before any polecat base dump, feature, re-ranker or test number existed (base training jobs / 9f1a9898 were running; no test score had been read)
question: Do the coverage / cold-entity mechanisms (GraphBridge typed bridge + stage-2 ranker, 6.1 pattern-reachable evidence, 6.5 gated augmentation) add measurable full-test MRR ON TOP OF the history re-ranker on a benchmark where no-pair-history and first-seen mass is large?

dataset.name: tkgl-polecat (TGB 2.0), TGB split 70/15/15 by timestamp quantile
dataset.variant: official (self-loops kept). The self-loop-free variant is NOT re-trained; instead a self-loop stratum (s == o) of the official run is reported.
dataset.protocol: time-aware filtered, both directions (inverse relation r+16), 1-vs-all over 150,931 entities, ground-truth online history before t; exact filtered ranks from full base score rows

bases.regcn: harness base_dump.py native-torch RE-GCN v6, h 200, 2 layers, history 10, 12 epochs, seed 42
bases.logcl: harness base_dump.py LogCL, same config, cl_weight 0.1
bases.tirgn: optional; only if the pure-torch shim fits ~4 h (expected not to: per-timestamp history cache over 1,826 days x 151k entities)

systems.HR: history re-ranker = residual-track arm B: MLP d->64->64->1 (zero-init last layer) trained standalone with listwise CE over C_hr = base top-50, features F_hist; final score alpha*log p_base + beta*f with (alpha,beta) = argmin valid-select NLL (LBFGS). 3 seeds.
systems.HR_R: secondary: residual arm R0 over C_hr with F_hist (s = log p_base + f, residual-in-loss). 3 seeds.
systems.HRCOV: history re-ranker + coverage = the same arm-B recipe over C_cov = base top-50 UNION first 50 pattern-prior candidates outside the top-50 UNION first 50 stage-2-bridge candidates outside both, features F_hist + F_cov. 3 seeds.
systems.HRCOV_R: secondary: R0 over C_cov with F_hist + F_cov. 3 seeds.
systems.HRCOVFEAT: diagnostic: arm B over C_hr with F_hist + F_cov (coverage features without coverage candidates). 3 seeds.
systems.promotion_rule: a candidate outside the top-50 is promoted iff its fused score exceeds the lowest fused score inside the top-50 (gold-free); final list = promoted set sorted by fused score ++ base remainder in base order (residual-track fused_ranks_np). Base log-probs of coverage candidates come from an exact full-row lookup, so every fused rank is exact.
systems.F_hist: 8 base features (log p, log p - log p1, log base rank, in-top-50 flag, p1, top-50 entropy, margin12, log tail mass) + 11 online evidence features (exact-triple count, dyad count, their recencies, triple count in last 30 snapshots, (r',c) popularity + recency, entity frequency, BridgeMem dyadic LR, query recurrence, subject frequency), all from facts with ts < t. The 6 u_pred features of the residual track are DROPPED (no event-LM vocabulary for polecat).
systems.F_cov: pattern features (best pattern-prior utility of any pattern containing c, best hierarchical TE confidence, log #patterns containing c, pattern-reachable flag, log position in the pattern-prior list) + bridge features (in-bridge flag, stage-2 ensemble score, log position in the bridge list, log1p path multiplicity from subject, log1p #intermediates) + coverage-candidate flag

coverage_only_references.BR_CS: stage-2 bridge ranker (G12 arm5 features without the event-LM column: X16 + cascade, 3-seed ensemble, trained on 8,000 coverage-hard TRAIN queries (gold outside base top-50, reached by the bridge; both directions)) used as a backfill through the harness ConfidenceSwitch(q in {.05,.10,.20,.30}, M in {0,1,3,10,K}, B in {10,50,200}); config by valid-sample MRR
coverage_only_references.PAT_BUMP: 6.1 non-learned pattern prior (hierarchical target-encoded pattern confidence fitted on early-70% train timestamps, M1=64/M2=32 caps): s' = log p + delta*1[c in top-B of the pattern-prior list], B in {10,30,100,300}, delta in {0.25,0.5,1,2,4,8}; (B,delta) by valid-sample MRR
coverage_only_references.AUG: 6.5 utility-gated augmentation. Oracle first: inject only the gold quad (m=1 and m=3) when the structural pool (bridge top-20 UNION pattern-prior top-20) proposes it, on a uniform 20k test sample, frozen base rescored (harness rescore_lib mechanism). STOP RULE: the gated arms (utility gate vs random / triadic-closure / uncertainty gates at matched budget) are run only for a base whose oracle-gate (m=3) full-test-extrapolated dMRR >= 0.002; otherwise they are reported as not run (ceiling below materiality x2). LLM generator not run (TGB slice 2018-2022 is pre-cutoff; 6.5 measured a contamination signature).

primary_rule.statement: The coverage stack is 'useful on polecat' iff, on BOTH bases (RE-GCN and LogCL), HRCOV beats HR on full-test MRR with one-sided paired-bootstrap p < 0.05 AND dMRR >= 0.001, AND the head-damage guardrail passes for HRCOV vs HR.
primary_rule.statistic: per-query reciprocal ranks averaged over the 3 seeds of each system; paired Poisson(1) bootstrap over queries, B = 2000 (oih_common.paired_bootstrap); one-sided p = P_boot(delta <= 0)
primary_rule.guardrail: head stratum (gold train frequency >= 500): DAMAGE iff the 95% CI of dMRR lies entirely below 0 AND |dMRR| >= 0.001; DAMAGE fails the rule
primary_rule.selection: every hyperparameter, epoch, calibration weight, bump/backfill config and gate threshold is chosen on VALID only (valid timestamps < 70% quantile = fit, rest = select). Test is scored once per system.

reported_regardless: full-test table (MRR, H@1/3/10) for RecB-lite, both bases, HR, HR_R, HRCOV, HRCOV_R, HRCOVFEAT, BR_CS, PAT_BUMP, AUG oracle (+ gated arms if run)

per-stratum dMRR (HRCOV - HR and each system - base): no-pair-history (no (s,o) event before t), first-seen entity (subject or gold without any event before t), pool-absent (gold outside base top-50), cold/mid/head, the 9-category error taxonomy (E, R_in/out, D_in/out, P_in/out, U_in/out on the base top-50 pool), no-pair & 2-hop-reachable vs no-pair & unreachable, self-loop queries

oracle ceilings: gold-in-pool@1, pattern reach (any / 1-hop / 2-hop-only) and pattern-list reach at B in {10,50,300}, bridge reach (natural set and stage-2 list at B in {10,50,200}) with a random-candidate control at matched set size, C_cov@1, augmentation oracle
official py-tgb Evaluator rows for the bases (and the final systems if the full-row pass is run), plus published TGB leaderboard rows with protocol differences stated
secondary_reading: HRCOV_R vs HR_R reported with the same statistic; not decisive. If HRCOV passes on one base only the verdict is 'not useful (base-dependent)'.
